source: schedule_plan reconstruction of the sealed M49 paid_suffix first candidates. Not a new search.
legal_swap_boundary: One swap before an unstarted launch restores that sortie to 0.5. The same sortie is not swapped again. A started airborne residual cannot take a swap. The reported energy is the running balance at the first stage that ends below 0.05 after that rule.

seed_1001_d13.reading: The flight after a full swap stays above 0.05. The later truck-wait hover is the stage that crosses the reserve. This is not a single flight segment larger than one battery.

seed_1002_d14.reading: Minus 0.386112 is the balance after the wait, not the cruise segment. The cruise ended at 0.083, still above 0.05. The wait of about 1266 seconds then spends 0.469. A second swap is not inserted because this sortie already swapped and is airborne.
